intro:
Nanchang uprising — 1 August 1927

Comrades, our alliance with the Kuomintang has broken. Other units are joining the rising here at Nanchang, but the local government troops still hold the city and surround our positions on the Gan.

Strike the old city as the supporting columns come in from the other approaches. Take the junctions between our groups before the garrison can defeat them separately. The rising needs control of Nanchang if it is to survive its first day.

We must get Soviet aid by sea with another uprising in Guangzhou. Our comrades there will receive our support from Nanchang.

Autumn Harvest uprising — 7 September 1927

Another rising is being organised in Hunan and Jiangxi after the fighting at Nanchang. Changsha is its intended centre, but the groups marching towards it are unevenly trained and armed.

Join the gathering forces and take the positions covering their approach. Bring the columns together before committing them against the city. The local Kuomintang troops need only catch them separately to stop the rising before it can establish a base.

Hold the bases and break up the columns before they can close a continuous ring. Use the wooded approaches to gather against an exposed group, then move before its neighbours arrive. Both the field force and the villages supporting it must survive the offensive.

Luding Bridge — 29 May 1935

The march has reached the Dadu River. The pursuers are closing from behind, and the army cannot remain crowded against the water while supplies run down.

Take Luding Bridge and secure the approaches on the far bank. Liu Wenhui's local forces hold the crossing; even a small garrison can delay an army on this narrow route. Keep the passage open for the columns following the assault group.

The Japanese invasion has brought us into an uneasy alliance with the Kuomintang. Our troops are to strike the enemy's rear while other Chinese forces engage the main advance.

The Japanese Fifth Division is moving towards Pingxingguan Pass. Block its route and attack the columns caught on the road. Use the country around the pass to approach without exposing the detachments early; the enemy's strength is harder to bring to bear on a narrow, obstructed road.

The main objectives must be the capture of enemy resources present in your area: the coal mines and factories. Your battle plan includes some cities and don't forget to cut all enemy lines of communication.

Act as quick as possible, the Japanese are going to use all available means to defeat any try to stop their penetration into China.

Hungnam Pocket [Korean War]

11-12-1950, Hungnam, North Korea.

Again, your smashing attack has left the enemy forces on the ground isolated. This is the situation at Hungnam. The UN forces are surrounded from the North and South by us while the North Korean units will attack from the East. However, the Hungnam port continues to be their main lifeline, supported by their overwhelming naval power.

Your mission is to reach the port of Hungnam while destroying all enemy forces along your way. You must stop any UN evacuation as soon as possible. A successful evacuation will be a victory for them. The 2nd, 6th and 10th North Korean divisions (the 2nd Korean People's Army) will be under your direct command and the 20th PLA will arrive from the South as reinforcements.

Seoul, beyond the 38th Paralell, near the pre-war dividing line.

25-1-1951

The lightning advances of December and early January provide us with the opportunity to easily retake Seoul for the North Koreans. However, the situation is becoming dangerous. Our supply lines to China are long and are constantly being bombed and strafed by the UN air force. Because of this they are preparing a counterattack to again liberate Seoul. Our Korean spies have told us that a great number of troops are concentrating South of Suwon, including modern tanks and heavy artillery.

Be careful, our troops are nearly exhausted due to the quick advances in the past months. Your mission is to protect Seoul at all costs and if possible defeat the capitalist advance.

1-12-1955, Beijing.

Private Tovarich! Nice to see you again. It has been a while since our last meeting at Khabarovsk. We need to take China back to the right and true communist way. We think you and your so-called ''Gang of Four'' are the perfect team to take down the Maoist system and that destructive plan named ''Great Leap Forward''. That woman of your gang, ''Madame Mao'' can be very useful in the near future, when you will need to destroy the political image of Mao.

We are ready to support you by sea. The Chinese navy will remain loyal to Mao, but it is not powerful enough to deal with a minor Soviet submarine unit. After we secure the entire coast by taking Tanggu, you must launch the counterattack against the government loyalist units which surely will be sent to defeat our plans. Take the Tanggu airfield as soon as possible as this will allow us to send you reinforcements by air. Our planes will be painted with the PRC symbols. You must avoid the Americans as we don't need any problems with them now. The incident should be only between Chinese forces.

The last stand will be Beijing, this won't be easy, as you know, the best PLA units are deployed there. The price maybe high, but it deserves a try. You can become the new premier of the People's Republic of China!
